$Comment: The feast stall. Season makes the stall, and every offer naming it, absent while the feast is off.
Order 90 keeps it behind a server's everyday storefronts, so a shop block or a conversation line that
opens the first storefront never lands here. It carries no Where, so it opens in any world and follows
Martha wherever a server stands her: players reach it through her, and Season closes it while the feast
Everything here is priced in festival tokens, the currency every season shares. Includes carries the
festival shelf (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Festival_Stall) beside the host's own goods: the offers every
season's host shares, with one purchase limit across them all, each on sale only in its own Season
or Dates (so the winter pieces show here and the Pumpkin Basket does not). The shelf brings its own
wallet, place and name, so the header shows festival tokens and the festival shelf follows the host's
own shelves with no line of its own here. CategoryOrder fixes the order of the host's own shelves, and
each one's name is a key in harvestfeast.progression.lang.
